# HUD

**Category:** Render  
**Aliases:** HUD

## What it does

Shows an in-game overlay with various useful tools.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/render/hud). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
